notes.title: Bug Reporter Patch
notes.content:
This patch adds a way for players to submit bug report data! 

In the settings menu there is now a bit of text at the bottom that indicates the game version. If you click on that version number ten times, your session data and game save data will be uploaded to a location where we can look at it to help fix bugs.

If you encounter an issue that you want to report, make sure you ALSO post about your issue on the Steam forums or on Discord so that we can reach you with further questions.

Thanks again for helping us make the game better!

notes.title: July Bugfix Update
notes.content:
Today’s patch includes fixes for a bunch of (un)popular bugs reported by our players:
 - Fixed an issue where seeds could be accidentally permanently destroyed
 - Fixed a rare situation where the level selector knob was missing or unusable
 - Fixed the font configuration for Japanese and Korean to prevent some characters going missing in text
 - Fixed a bug that could prevent you from entering the Clocktower in the tutorial if you started the game in smooth locomotion mode
 - Fixed situations where the game could run at an incorrect framerate when using Steam Link, Quest Link, or Pico Link.

Thank you to everyone who helped us track down these issues!

notes.title: March Bugfix Patch
notes.content:
Today's patch includes a bundle of performance improvements and bug fixes!
[list]
[*] Performance and frame-pacing improvements
[*] Detection and fix for frame rate changes between saves
[*] Texture improvements to gloves
[*] Out-of-bounds teleport fixes
[*] Inventory seed collision & count tracking fixes
[*] Input detection & foregrounding fixes when navigating between various system menus
[*] Avoiding double-binding the menu buttons to respect system dominant hand choices
[/list]
As always, thank you to the players who helped us identify these issues, and thank you all for playing!

notes.title: New languages now supported!
notes.content:
Hi Clockwinder Community,

We are happy to announce that The Last Clockwinder now supports a bunch of new languages:
 [list]
[*]French
[*]German
[*]Japanese
[*]Korean
[*]Spanish 
[/list]
The user interface was fully translated and subtitles have been added for all spoken lines.

We took extra special care to make sure the translations were as good as they could be. If there are any issues please do let us know. 

Thanks as always for playing The Last Clockwinder and giving us your support! Thank you so very much!

– The Pontoco Team

notes.title: June Bugfix Patch
notes.content:
This update brings a number of small fixes and improvements to The Last Clockwinder!

- Added visual smoothing on clones at end of loops
- Fix levers colliding with smooth movement capsule on the player
- Reduce loading lag when entering the game and changing platforms
- Reduce loading lag in main menu
- Use controller velocity sensors to increase throwing accuracy
- Fix certain places where player could become stuck in smooth motion mode
- Increase max turn speed to 270
- Fix SteamVR entering and exiting game view at startup

notes.title: Last Day for The Steam Award Nominations + Raindance Immersive Results
notes.content:
Happy Monday, all! We hope those in the U.S. had a wonderful Thanksgiving, and everyone else had an equally great weekend!

Our big news from the last few days is that The Last Clockwinder earned an honorable mention at the Raindance Immersive Awards, where we were nominated in the Best Immersive Game category.

This is the first time The Last Clockwinder has been recognized by an awards organization and our whole team is incredibly grateful. All of the nominees did an incredible job of showcasing the future of immersive gameplay.

On a similar note, there's only one day left to help The Last Clockwinder secure a nomination for the VR Game of the Year category of the Steam Awards. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/SteamAwards]You can vote here[/url].

Voting Details
---------------
- There are 11 categories in the Steam Awards.
- Each person can only submit a game once, so give some thought to which game you think is the best fit for which category.
- You'll have until November 29th to submit your nominations.
- Voting will happen during the Winter Sale.

Thank you so much and enjoy the rest of your week!

notes.title: Nominate The Last Clockwinder for VR Game of the Year!
notes.content:
Nominations for the 2022 Steam Awards are now open, and as this is the year that The Last Clockwinder made its debut, we're especially excited to see what awards season will hold.

If you've played and enjoyed The Last Clockwinder, we would absolutely love to be considered as your nomination for [b]VR Game of the Year[/b]!

Voting Details
---------------
- There are 11 categories in the Steam Awards.
- Each person can only submit a game once, so give some thought to which game you think is the best fit for which category.
- You'll have until November 29th to submit your nominations.
- Voting will happen during the Winter Sale.

notes.title: Minor Bug Fix Patch
notes.content:
- A bug has been fixed that, on rare occasions, caused players to load into the Main Menu far above the floor and with unresponsive hands.
- Switches on audio devices are no longer able to wander away from their intended location.
- The achievement in the Library room is now a bit more achievable.

notes.title: Minor Device Support Patch
notes.content:
- Some VR devices that aren't officially supported are now allowed to start the game, with a cautionary note.
- Startup logos can be skipped using the trigger (instead of the 'A' button).

notes.title: Post-Launch Patch
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixes a token in the Fuel Generator room that didn't reappear after you leave the room and come back
[*] Fixes a puzzle that you could solve with two hands when you are supposed to need three
[*] Fixes a funnel that would sometimes get Luftapples jammed
[*] Fixes the case of the missing gloves in the Study room
[*] Fixes a case where the radio would keep ringing even when you can't get to it
[*] Fixes the final credits text being in an unexpected position
[*] Fixes a collector that could collect the wrong types of things
[*] Adds a startup check and some advice for when the game starts in an unsupported configuration
[/list]
